subject: Finalizing ground transfers & night-handoff windows - Zenith workshop
messages:
From: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@zenithsolutions.com>
To: nikhil_sharma@redwood.com; camila_reyes@redwood.com
Cc: ops@zenithsolutions.com
Date: 2026-11-30T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Workshop arrival windows + shuttle/overnight handoff

Hi Nikhil / Camila —

Thanks for the logistics note. Two quick asks from our side: can the ground transfers accommodate an 11:00PM arrival from SFO for two executives (Caroline Hale, Evan Briggs) who end up on the late redeye? Also, we have one senior attendee (Caroline) who needs a guaranteed single room and a late check-in. Can you confirm an option for a night-handback where the Redwood escort meets our shuttle at 23:30 and does a room key handoff at the hotel desk?

I attached the pax manifest with meal prefs and passport initials. We can be flexible on shuttle size but would prefer one consolidated vehicle rather than two smaller cars.

Erin
Senior Ops, Zenith Solutions

Attachments: Zenith_MAL-Manifest.pdf, zenith-flight-pax-20261201.csv

From: nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
To: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@zenithsolutions.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com; laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-30T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Workshop arrival windows + shuttle/overnight handoff

Erin —

Got it. Short answers up front: yes on the consolidated vehicle and yes on the late-hand off. Proposed plan:

- Arrival window: shuttle pick-up scheduled for 23:10 at SFO curb (we'll allow a 20-min buffer for customs/immigration).
- Redwood escort: Camila will meet the shuttle at 23:20 and ride with the delegation to the hotel.
- Night handoff: Redwood will coordinate with the hotel to have keys at the desk; our escort will verify IDs and sign the log.
- Single room guarantee: we've flagged Caroline in the hotel booking; Laura will confirm the single-room allocation with the hotel and email you a confirmation number.

Couple of follow-ups: please confirm flight numbers for the two late arrivals (so our driver monitors delays) and let us know if any of the delegation carry specialized equipment (audio dongles / presentation laptop).

I'll attach the updated shuttle window options once Laura confirms hotel backfill.

Thanks,
Nikhil
Travel Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachments: shuttle-window-options.xlsx

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: nikhil_sharma@redwood.com; camila_reyes@redwood.com; Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@zenithsolutions.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T08:43:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Workshop arrival windows + shuttle/overnight handoff

Quick update from the hotel: I have a tentative guarantee for Caroline's single room (CONF# HZ-45921). Hotel will hold the room until 01:00 AM with the late check-in note; after that they'll release it unless we provide a credit card imprint. They also requested the estimated arrival time for the group to pre-stage keys and the access cards.

Erin — can you send me the final pax ETA by 14:00 PT today and the card to hold the room, or I can take a company card on file (Redwood will cover incidental hold if that helps).

Camila — pls confirm you'll be at the SFO curb at 23:20 so we can close this loop.

- Laura
Events & Travel, Redwood Inference

From: camila_reyes@redwood.com
To: nikhil_sharma@redwood.com; laura_bennett@redwood.com; Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@zenithsolutions.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T17:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Workshop arrival windows + shuttle/overnight handoff

Confirmed — I'll be on-site at SFO (curb 5, Terminal 2) at 23:15. Driver will text when they're five minutes out; I'll have the phone number for ops@zenithsolutions.com saved and will call ahead if there's any delay.

Erin: I captured Caroline and Evan's flight numbers from the manifest you sent (UA1756 and AS432). I'll watch them and update if either diverts. Laura — please proceed with the CONF# HZ-45921 hold; Redwood will take the incidental authorization on file and I'll bring the signed handoff log.

One more note: hotel valet closes at midnight — if the group needs car retrieval before morning we'll coordinate with the desk.

See you all later this week.

- Camila
Senior Events Coordinator, Redwood Inference
